name: chocolatey
description: Windows package manager with dependency resolution and automation

tools.description: PowerShell-based package manager with community repository support
tools.usage:
choco install firefox -y # Install package without prompts
choco upgrade all --except="package1,package2" # Update all except specified
choco search --by-id-only nodejs # Exact package ID search
choco list --local-only --include-programs # List all installed software
choco pin add --name="package" # Pin package to prevent updates
